newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures steady to down in after-hours.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures steady to down in after-hours.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were steady to lower in after-hours trade on Tuesday, as selling orders from the day's trading remained, traders said.
Prices were unchanged to 0.4 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was unchanged at 141.0 yen. Daily volume was 4,586 lots.

During the day, local investors sold, particularly distant months, traders said. The yen's gains against the dollar accelerated selling orders, they said. "The Tokyo market price falls also discouraged participants," a trader said.
